Alex Carter: Kickoff: preflight for NorthPoint private VPC bring-up (eu-west-1) — going to run through air-gapped image mirror, BGP peering check, and GPU farm validation. ETA 2h. @Priya Nair can you confirm registry mirror plan? :rocket:
Priya Nair: Confirming. Plan: create an offline registry on customer bastion, push images via portable tar + `skopeo copy`. Keys: cert fingerprints must match. Steps:
```
# on builder
docker save redwood/svc:1.2 -o svc-1.2.tar
scp svc-1.2.tar bastion:/var/tmp/
# on bastion
docker load -i svc-1.2.tar
skopeo copy docker-daemon:svc:latest docker://localhost:5000/svc:1.2 --dest-tls-verify=false
```
Also need to sync `/etc/ssl/certs` from control plane for internal CA.
Mateo Ruiz: Network notes: customer is using static routes to their firewall; we need MTU 9000 on node interfaces, confirm `ip link` before CNI. Also ensure allowed ports: 22, 443, 2379-2380, 10250-10255, 9000-9100 (node exporters), and the GPU vendor ports for driver installer. Verify NAT rules for model pull fallback. Example check:
```
# mtu
ip link show eth0
# kube API reachability
curl -k https://api.internal.cluster:6443/healthz
```
OpsBot: registry-sync job finished: 36 images mirrored, size 68GB. artifact-id: registry-sync-1999990000. Logs: /artifacts/1999990000/registry.log
Jen Lin: GPU health: first node shows 4x A100 but drivers mismatched (470 vs required 525). Install steps using `nvidia-driver-installer.run` from offline driver bundle. Also ensure `nvidia-container-toolkit` is present for container runtime. MIG profile planning: 2xMIG per GPU for predicted load.
Ravi Singh: Cost / capacity: customer asked for burstable capacity; suggest 30% on-demand reserved in Dedicated pool and 70% billed as spot with automatic fallback. We'll present cost delta. Also note region constraint — eu-west-1 has limited A100 inventory, lead time 3-5 days.
Alex Carter: Action items: Priya mirror finished by T+45m; Mateo validate BGP/static and MTU T+30m; Jen push driver bundle to bastion and run installer T+90m; Ravi prepare two-line cost delta and SLA note. I'll run cluster validation script and post summary. Ping me on thread when done. :white_check_mark:
Priya Nair: ack, starting mirror now.
Mateo Ruiz: running `ip link` now, seeing MTU 1500 on two nodes — will set to 9000 and report.
Jen Lin: uploaded driver bundle to bastion at /var/tmp/np-driver-bundle.tar.gz
OpsBot: validation-run queued: /pipelines/1999990000/cluster-validate --quick
Alex Carter: Thanks team, will post final validation and handoff checklist once green.
